summary: The change matches the plan's seams and tests, but the orchestrator's escalation rule lost its lite-only scope, contradicting DESIGN.md and ADR 0014, and there are commit-unit, reuse and documentation-consistency gaps.

findings.summary: The analyze escalation bullet is no longer limited to lite runs, so a full-chain run with CRITICAL or HIGH on its first analysis re-runs clarify, grill-with-docs, plan and tasks instead of entering the repair cycle.
findings.evidence: SKILL.md:102 'Any CRITICAL or HIGH, and no -full.md report in analyze.reports yet: escalate', no chain qualifier. DESIGN.md:199; ADR 0014 Decision 3; plan T009 scope 'lite escalation on CRITICAL/HIGH unchanged'; docs/factory-overview.md routes full-chain CRITICAL/HIGH to Repair1. Constitution Principle I.
findings.fix: Qualify the escalate bullet at SKILL.md:102 with 'On a lite run,'.

findings.summary: Commits T004 through T008 each leave tools/tests/test_recovery.py red (9 failures), and the fixture repair landed in the later T013 commit, outside those units.
findings.evidence: ENG-3. Exported snapshots show 9 test_recovery.KillAndResumeTests failures at e9bbfd7 (T004), 39668b3 (T005), 60c9480 (T006), 351a531 (T007) and 7ca220a (T008); none at 4cc2779 (T003); e8beb84 (T013) runs 410 tests with none. tasks.md T013 says 'runs the test and build commands only' yet edits test_recovery.py. Branch tip green; gap is in intermediate commits.
findings.fix: Do not rewrite history. Record in the PR body that e9bbfd7 through 7ca220a are red in test_recovery until e8beb84 lands the fixture repair.

findings.summary: The four-count validation is written twice, once inline in cmd_analyze_record and once in state.analyze_record_problems, so the two can drift apart.
findings.evidence: ENG-6. commands.py:989-992 vs state.py:367-380; commands.py:1010 repeats the tuple. commands.py already imports state (commands.py:18).
findings.fix: Move the count loop into state.py and call it from cmd_analyze_record; use state.ANALYZE_COUNTS at commands.py:1010.

findings.summary: _unanswered_user_questions skips the version-1 top-level relay questions shape that rounds_of accepts, so a legacy requires_user question would not block the implement gate.
findings.evidence: ENG-6. checks.py:250-262 reads only relay.get('rounds'); commands.py:76-84 rounds_of handles relay['questions']; state.py:403-406; DESIGN.md 'Schema v4'.
findings.fix: Move rounds_of into state.py and call it from both commands.py and _unanswered_user_questions.

findings.summary: The lite chain is still documented as 'one pass, no loop', but the new gate routing and ADR 0014 apply the repair-cycle cap on either chain.
findings.evidence: DESIGN.md:181, DESIGN.md:75, SKILL.md:98 vs ADR 0014 Decision 3, SKILL.md step 5 item 4, docs/factory-overview.md.
findings.fix: Update DESIGN.md:75 and :181 and SKILL.md:98: lite is one analysis before escalation, with repair cycles capped at two on either chain.

findings.summary: The new Python lines run past the 88-column width that the neighbouring code keeps.
findings.evidence: ENG-7. origin/main test_gates.py and test_analyze_record.py have 0 lines over 88; this diff adds 27.
findings.fix: Wrap the added lines to 88 columns.
